outcome: Consumption of personal protective equipment and products (PPEP) (masks, gloves, gowns, caps, alcohol-based products, soap)
Surgical site infection (SSI) rate after cesarean section
cohort: Non-COVID-19 patients undergoing cesarean sections in a public teaching hospital in Porto Alegre, Brazil
finding: The study found a significant increase in PPEP consumption and a decrease in SSI rate after the emergence of the COVID-19 pandemic.
mod_finding: The study found a decrease in surgical site infections after Cesarean sections following the onset of the COVID-19 pandemic, potentially due to increased PPE use.
